newsitem.title: USA: Smart Choice Automotive obtains more credit.
newsitem.headline: Smart Choice Automotive obtains more credit.

text.p: Smart Choice Automotive Group Inc said on Tuesday that it had obtained an increased credit line from Finova Capital Corp, bringing the total credit available to $35 million.
Smart Choice, formerly Eckler Industries Inc, said the increased credit line would allow the company to continue expansion in its automobile finance division.
The company also announced the opening of an additional used car center located in Pinellas Park, Fla.
Smart Choice Automotive Group Inc consolidates new and used car dealerships and finance companies and owns 10 used car centers.
